item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a rigorous before/after metric showing that regional relations in 2024 were objectively more peaceful or lawful than in early 2024. The evidence is event-based: strong de-escalation in Gaza, but simultaneous militarized signaling and an arms transfer to Somalia. That makes the overall judgment mixed rather than clearly positive.","evidence":[{"title":"Joint Statement from Egypt, Qatar and the United States","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"Aug. 16, 2024","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news1682024/","summary":"Egypt co-led a bridging proposal for a Gaza ceasefire and hostage/detainee release deal, explicitly tied to UNSC Resolution 2735 and humanitarian provisions.
